name: Activepieces
tagline: Open source no-code automation. Zapier alternative with self-hosting.
shortDescription: Activepieces is an open source no-code automation platform. 300+ integrations, visual flow builder, TypeScript pieces, self-hostable, the modern open source Zapier/Make alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

Activepieces is an open source no-code automation platform. 300+ pre-built pieces (integrations), visual flow builder, TypeScript pieces you can write and share, self-hostable, and growing fast.

## Why we recommend it

If you want Zapier/Make but with self-hosting and open source, Activepieces is the answer. The pieces are TypeScript (familiar to developers), the UI is modern, and the platform is being actively developed.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Zapier/Make alternative
- Internal automations (no per-task fees)
- Building custom pieces in TypeScript
- When you want to own your automation data
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name activepieces -p 80:80 activepieces/activepieces
```

**Cloud:** Free tier (1K tasks/month). From $30/month for production.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: 1K tasks/month free. $30/month for production.
